description: غذای کامل گربه بالغ. گربه‌های عقیم‌شده به دلیل تغییر سوخت‌وساز به رژیمی کم‌انرژی‌تر نیاز دارند.
bodyDescription: Sterilized cats need a less energy-rich diet due to an altered metabolism. Psyllium and beet pulp provide a greater sense of satiety and also help reduce the formation of hairballs. L-carnitine is added to boost fat burning. A unique blend of dried plants – naturally rich in antioxidants – contribute to good immunity. Clinical studies show that plaque and tartar formation are reduced thanks to the added phosphorylated vitamin C. The amount of minerals is tailored to contribute to a healthy urinary tract. Fish oil promotes healthy skin and coat. Finally, joint-supporting components have also been added. Formulated without maize or wheat.
